e: Hakainde Hichilema sworn in as president for second term.
Brian Mundubile is charged with treason.
Police arrest 11 people in Lusaka, including opposition candidate Brian Mundubile on suspicion of plotting an insurrection.
A court in South Africa orders the return of former president Edgar Lungu’s body, shortly after the Zambian government claimed it had taken possession of the remains.
A minibus collides with another vehicle in Kalomo District, killing eight people and injuring 12 others.
National Democratic Congress secretary general Mambwe Zimba is arrested over an altered picture of president Hichilema.
The government bans the import of livestock and related products from South Africa due to an outbreak of foot-and-mouth disease.

The High Court orders the seizure of more than $1.3 million in assets from Dalitso Lungu, the son of former president Edgar Lungu, citing failure to adequately explain the circumstances of their acquisition.
Ghana and Zambia agree to abolish visa requirements for each other’s citizens.
